footprint.symmetry: bilateral symmetry along front-back and left-right axes

raw_elements: tiered roof with multiple receding slabs
raw_hints: Build rectangular base foundation with stonebrick approximately 12×10 blocks
Construct two main floor levels with wood plank walls, each approximately 4-5 blocks tall
Place glass windows symmetrically: 3 windows on upper floor, 2 on lower floor with corner ornaments
Create stepped roof by stacking horizontal stone slabs in receding layers (5-6 layers total)
Ensure each roof layer is progressively smaller, centered on the structure
Add decorative corner blocks (brick/gold) at window corners on lower floor
rebuild_intent.summary: A tiered pagoda-style tower structure with 2 main floors and a distinctive stepped roof crown. The building features wood plank walls with decorative glass windows, a stone foundation base, and ornamental corner details. The roof consists of multiple receding horizontal slabs creating a pyramid-like silhouette.
